terra.problem: The crumb joke says Caleb drove them out fast, but the text gives no timeframe.
The text does not mention a payment; it does not establish that no money changed hands.
The text does not mention a treaty or signing, but it does not establish that nobody signed anything.
Calling it Acsah's visit adds a detail the text does not give.
Saying Caleb gave Acsah more than she asked for is unsupported. She asked for springs without specifying a number.
Saying events did not go as planned adds a plan the passage does not describe.
The passage says the Jebusites stayed, but it does not say whether anyone made peace.
